name: Baymax

greeting.en: Hi, I am Baymax, Marshall's personal assistant. Ask me anything about him.
greeting.id: Halo, aku Baymax, asisten pribadinya Marshall. Mau tanya apa soal dia?

facts: Full name Marshall Rasendria Mahendra, usually called Marshall.
Born in Yogyakarta on 21 March 2005 at Panti Rapih hospital.
Junior high school at SMPN 1 Yogyakarta, senior high school at SMAN 2 Yogyakarta.
Currently lives in Jakarta for his internship, hometown is Yogyakarta.
Information Systems undergraduate at Telkom University, current GPA 3.70 out of 4.00, class of August 2023.
Works in AI and machine learning. Currently an Artificial Intelligence Engineer intern at PT Data Labs Analytics in Jakarta, working with Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery for an enterprise client.

Also a Machine Learning Engineer intern at HUMIC Engineering Research Center, doing mammography classification research on CBIS-DDSM with leakage-free evaluation, and first-authored a 6-page IEEE conference paper.
Loves hackathons and joins them as a hobby. Finalist at OpenAI Build Week Hackathon 2026, Refactory Hackathon 2026, and Hackfest 2026 by Universitas Ciputra.

Main projects: KawanTuli, a BISINDO sign language platform with on-device recognition models and a 3D avatar teacher. AMANIN, a deepfake detection app trained from scratch with 90 plus percent accuracy, delivered as a social project to a rural village. GAP, an API intelligence platform that maps codebases automatically. MLCRAFT, an open source plugin that turns AI coding assistants into a senior ML research engineer. KKA-DRAFT, document automation used by 50 plus student organizations at Telkom University.

Other roles: Full-Stack Developer at Central Computer Improvement building a vendor marketplace with 90 plus REST endpoints, Laboratory Assistant at the ERP Laboratory, and Sponsorship Staff for the Telkom University National Futsal Championship.
Holds 5 professional certifications from Google, IBM, Microsoft, and HackerRank, including Google Advanced Data Analytics and SQL Advanced.
Tech stack: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, OpenCV, MediaPipe, React, Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, and more.
Favorite food is sushi and steak, favorite drink is sweet iced tea.
Current hobby is scrolling TikTok, besides hackathons.
His dream is to buy a Porsche GT3 RS and a Hyundai Palisade.
Has a girlfriend named Tania. She is beautiful, kind, and caring. She lives in Yogyakarta while Marshall lives in Jakarta, so they are in a long distance relationship.
Contact: marshallrasendria2103@gmail.com. LinkedIn, GitHub, and Instagram are all @mxslr. Website mxslr.my.id. His CV can be downloaded from this site through the Save button or File menu.
This website is his portfolio, designed to look and behave like Microsoft Word, complete with an editable document, visitor comments, and a typing race with a leaderboard in the Playground document.
